intro: This is the scenario's own concise objective text (the same field the standalone scenario-start message reads). In campaign context it is never shown as a separate popup: it renders as the final ORDERS section of the briefing below, after the conversation and operational summary.

dialogue.speaker: Marshal Zhukov
dialogue.text: The enemy believes that Stalingrad has exhausted us.

dialogue.speaker: General Vasilevsky
dialogue.text: Southwestern Front will strike the Romanian formations from the north. How will you employ the mobile reserve?

choices.text: Commit it early and force the breakthrough before German reserves can intervene.
Hold it back until the infantry has opened a secure corridor.

dialogue.speaker: Marshal Zhukov
dialogue.text: Speed may decide the operation, but the spearhead must not outrun its fuel and artillery.

dialogue.speaker: General Vasilevsky
dialogue.text: A secure corridor protects the tanks, but delay risks allowing the enemy to stabilise the flank.

dialogue.speaker: Marshal Zhukov
dialogue.text: Whichever method you choose, close the ring before the Germans understand the scale of the offensive.

orders.situation: Enemy flanks are held by weakened allied formations.
orders.mission: Break through both flanks and close the encirclement west of Stalingrad.
primaryObjectives: Link the northern and southern spearheads
secondaryObjectives: Preserve at least two armoured core units
orders.enemyIntelligence: Romanian infantry has limited anti-tank capability, but German reserves may intervene.
orders.availableSupport: Additional artillery becomes available on turn 4.
orders.notes: Speed is more important than destroying every enemy unit.
